unit.why: A brief anecdote quoted from Tiferet Shlomo about R. Zusha's daily habit of going to the market after the Torah blessings to find a Jew to bless; it is a minimal habitual narrative inside a homiletic anthology on prayer.
unit.boundary_note: borderline: habitual-practice anecdote rather than a single event; embedded in a homiletic compilation

stories.start_quote: וכן שמענו בשם הה״ק מו״ה זושא
stories.summary_en: Every day after the Torah blessings, R. Zusha went out to the market to find a Jew, whoever came first, and bestow his blessings on him.

tags.why: illustrates R. Zusha's love of Israel and generosity in blessing

quotes: לחפש אחר איש מזרע ישראל כדי להעניקו מברכותיו
tags.why: love of fellow Jews, generosity of blessing
daily liturgical blessing frames the act
quoted inside a homiletic discussion of prayer, citing a Torah commentary
